title: Rochester By Water
specs: Cruises include passage through Erie Canal locks
Themed kids cruises with crafts and educational activities
Children under 14 must be accompanied by an adult
Children ages 3 and under are free but must have a ticket per Coast Guard regulations
Notify in advance if bringing a service animal
Private charters available for groups and events up to 40 guests
includes: Live narration about local history and ecology
All materials and instructions for kids activities
Coast Guard-approved life jackets for every passenger
gap: Age minimum not stated for private charters
blurb: Guests can enjoy themed kids cruises with activities and crafts, private charters for events, and scenic tours through historic waterways including Erie Canal locks. Cruises vary from about 75 minutes to 2.5 hours and include narration about local history and ecology. The vessels depart from locations in Rochester and Pittsford, NY.
extraNote: Refunds or switches available if notified more than 24 hours before departure · No refunds or credits for cancellations within 24 hours · Cruises operate rain or shine unless captain cancels for safety · 12 Schoen Place, Pittsford, NY 14534 for Erie Canal cruises; 280 Exchange Blvd, Rochester, NY 14608 for Genesee River cruises · May through October
